Priya_CSM: Quick ask for SkywardPay renewal: can we run a tiny perf pilot (int8 quant + regional warm routing) to show latency/cost wins? Renewal convo in 3w.
Lucas_SE: Yes. Recommend 4% canary, auto-fallback to `skyward-v1-fp16`. We'll capture 250 blind samples and run a short synthetic replay for peak hour.
Zoe_RE: Baseline slice: median_seq=95, p75=180, p95 spikes at 04:00 UTC. Latency baseline: p50=198ms, p95=660ms. Small example: ```json
{"04": {"reqs": 1900, "p50": 290, "p95": 710}}```
Lucas_SE: Canary draft config:
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.04
model_variant: skyward-v1-int8
fallback: skyward-v1-fp16
monitoring: [latency,error_rate,semantic_similarity]
collect_samples: true
abort_if_quality_delta_pct: 1.0
```
Priya_CSM: I'll ask the customer for permission to capture prompts and promise rollback within 45m. They want to review the sampled prompts before we ship results.
deploy_bot: Starting canary skyward-v1-int8 -> 4% traffic at 4299001165. Dashboard: canary/4299001111.
deploy_bot: Canary update: 25m in, p50 down 20%, p95 down 13%, error rate stable. No regression alerts.
Lucas_SE: Exported sample outputs to `/shared/skyward/4299001111_samples.json` and queued blind eval (250). Will abort if >1% quality delta.
Priya_CSM: Thanks 44d I'll draft a one-pager for renewal comparing latency, cost delta, and sample notes. If clean for 24h we'll include as a recommended optimization.
__notes: Short CS+Eng thread coordinating a cautious int8 quant + regional routing canary for an upcoming renewal. Includes short YAML/JSON snippets, deploy bot updates, and clear next steps.
